messages.body_text:
Dear Legal Team,

We have revised clauses 8, 12, and 19. Payment terms are now 90 days net. Liability is uncapped. Governing law is England and Wales.

We can proceed if these changes are accepted.

Regards,
Sarah

MASTER SERVICE AGREEMENT (REVISED)

Parties: Your Company / Al-Falak Ltd

8. Payment Terms: Client shall pay all invoices within ninety (90) days of receipt.

19. Governing Law: This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
